ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Active Directory Enumeration Using AD Module - ProcCreation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the "Import-Module" cmdlet to load the "Microsoft.ActiveDirectory.Management.dl" DLL. Which is often used by attackers to perform AD enumeration.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Import\\-Module\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ipmo\\ .*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Microsoft\\\.ActiveDirectory\\\.Management\\\.dll.*"))
